toolkits.title: AI Policy Starter Kit for Schools
toolkits.useCase: District policy, classroom guidance, privacy, procurement, academic integrity, accessibility, and parent communication.
toolkits.starterText: Use this kit to align school leaders around practical classroom AI use, privacy, procurement, academic integrity, accessibility, and parent communication.

toolkits.title: Library AI Basics Deck
toolkits.useCase: A community session covering prompting, citations, hallucinations, scams, privacy, and daily tasks.
sections: What AI tools are useful for
toolkits.starterText: Run this as a 45- to 75-minute practical AI session for libraries, community rooms, churches, and adult learners.

toolkits.title: Main Street AI Workflow Templates
toolkits.audience: Small business owners and local teams
toolkits.useCase: Reusable templates for customer replies, estimates, inventory notes, hiring drafts, grant research, SOPs, and fraud-aware workflows.
toolkits.starterText: Give Main Street teams practical AI workflows they can test immediately without pretending the tools are magic or risk-free.

toolkits.title: Public Meeting AI Checklist
toolkits.useCase: Questions for procurement, public records, explainability, data rights, bias review, resident impact, and public accountability.
toolkits.starterText: Use this checklist before AI decisions disappear into procurement decks, vendor demos, or meeting minutes.

toolkits.title: AI Scam and Fraud Guide
toolkits.audience: Families, churches, banks, schools, local media
toolkits.useCase: Plain-language guidance on voice scams, fake invoices, phishing, deepfakes, and verification habits.
toolkits.starterText: Put simple verification habits in front of families, churches, schools, banks, and local media before AI scams become normal.

toolkits.title: Kentucky AI Opportunity Map
toolkits.useCase: A region-by-region view of programs, labs, employers, workshops, events, and gaps worth filling.
toolkits.starterText: Use this map to help students, founders, workforce partners, and funders see where Kentucky AI activity is real and where help is missing.

toolkits.title: Data Center Community Questions
toolkits.audience: Residents, local officials, reporters, schools, utility watchers
toolkits.useCase: A source-backed checklist for power, water, taxes, jobs, public meetings, local benefits, and environmental review.
toolkits.reviewNeeded: Energy, policy, and local government reviewers
toolkits.starterText: Give communities a grounded way to ask better questions about AI infrastructure before the decision window closes.
